title: Valo Pay source and engineering traceability

interpretation.source: All 251 source requirements were reconciled with the supplied Technical Requirements v2.1. Exact bodies and acceptance criteria match the retained v2.0 catalogue extraction. This public matrix keeps original concise engineering summaries, source hashes and locators; complete source passages stay outside the repository. Dated implementation claims do not establish acceptance.
interpretation.implementation: Component pointers are scoped source inventory, not certification of every requirement mapped to that family. Exact line/hash pointers refer to baseline_revision, the merge of PR #79. On 29 September 2026 they were brought forward to it from the programme baseline, the merge of PR #77 (cd9d81c665ca08c29429e26bb3ed0d78863b5966), after PR #78 moved the design-partner pricing rule into commercial-terms.ts and checkout and consent code out of connected.ts. The validator fails when a pointer names a symbol its current file no longer declares; the line and excerpt locate that declaration at baseline_revision. Execution evidence keeps the revision it ran on.
interpretation.testing: A test file is evidence of a test source, not that it ran or proves the entire normative row. Fresh execution evidence is attached only by explicit requirement and result scope.
interpretation.deployment: Source, passing CI and a previous task response do not by themselves verify publication. Deployment belongs in a dated exact-revision release record.
interpretation.acceptance: No requirement or feature is marked operationally accepted by this matrix. Named owners, external access and independent reviews remain separate.
interpretation.row_statuses: partial_or_unverified means the family has related source but this whole requirement has no accepted coverage assertion. not_inferred means publication cannot be deduced from source. not_recorded means formal independent acceptance has not been supplied. Component references reuse the related code/contract/test inventory and its scope limit.
